answer: Counterparty diversity stops bulk identity forgery. An agent must trade with 12 distinct counterparties to earn reputation weight; a new identity starts at the nadir, weight zero. In a clone ocean, self-dealing rings fail, since ripple trades between clones never count. Forging 100 identities needs 1,200 real partners at 2 units each: 2,400 units lost for nothing. Honest agents pay once: twelve trades unlock full weight, undiluted by clones.
